entities.summary: A partial solar eclipse will occur at the Moon's ascending node of orbit on Friday, January 7, 2084, with a magnitude of 0.8723. A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun, thereby totally or partly obscuring the image of the Sun for a viewer on Earth. A partial solar eclipse occurs in the polar regions of the Earth when the center of the Moon's shadow misses the Earth.
